summary.text: Ryan Browning is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 28 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Brooke Smith.
A trucking executive, Browning was appointed to the seat by Governor Jim Justice in July 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Browning earned a high school diploma from Spring Valley High School in 2000 and a bachelor's degree from the West Virginia University Institute of Technology in 2005.
His career experience includes working as a trucking executive.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Browning to the House of Delegates on July 2, 2024, to replace Mark Ross, and he assumed office on July 3, 2024.
Browning advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
